verify_email.description: Provides real-time email mailbox checking, including domain-specific logic and SMTP commands, to verify email addresses and remove up to 95% of bad emails, ensuring the inbox is live and reducing bounce rates. Includes features like typo correction, mobile domain detection, Whois details, and a Deliverability Confidence Score.

required_parameters.name: email
required_parameters.description: Input Email

get_random_word.description: Retrieves a random word based on specified constraints such as length and character patterns.

optional_parameters.name: wordLength
optional_parameters.description: The exact length of the random word to retrieve. A value of 0 means no exact length constraint.

optional_parameters.name: minLength
optional_parameters.description: The minimum length of the random word.

optional_parameters.name: maxLength
optional_parameters.description: The maximum length of the random word.

optional_parameters.name: includes
optional_parameters.description: The specific characters that must be contained within the word.

optional_parameters.name: excludes
optional_parameters.description: The specific characters that must not appear in the word.

optional_parameters.name: beginsWith
optional_parameters.description: The specific character or substring that the word must start with.

optional_parameters.name: endsWith
optional_parameters.description: The specific character or substring that the word must end with.

get_car_makes.description: Return all car makes from a dataset

get_vehicle_specifications.description: Provides comprehensive vehicle specification information. Users can filter vehicle data using combinations of manufacturer, model, fuel efficiency (MPG), cylinder count, transmission type, year, drive type, and fuel type.

optional_parameters.name: model
optional_parameters.description: Model of vehicle.

optional_parameters.name: make
optional_parameters.description: Vehicle manufacturer.

optional_parameters.name: min_city_mpg
optional_parameters.description: Minimum City fuel efficiency in miles per gallon.

optional_parameters.name: max_city_mpg
optional_parameters.description: Maximum city fuel efficiency in miles per gallon.

optional_parameters.name: min_hwy_mpg
optional_parameters.description: Minimum highway fuel efficiency in miles per gallon.

optional_parameters.name: max_hwy_mpg
optional_parameters.description: Maximum highway fuel efficiency in miles per gallon.

optional_parameters.name: min_comb_mpg
optional_parameters.description: Minimum combination (city + highway) fuel efficiency in miles per gallon.

optional_parameters.name: max_comb_mpg
optional_parameters.description: Maximum combination (city + highway) fuel efficiency in miles per gallon.

optional_parameters.name: cylinders
optional_parameters.description: Number of cylinders. Possible values: 2, 3 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16

optional_parameters.name: transmission
optional_parameters.description: Type of transmission. Possible values: manual, automatic

optional_parameters.name: year
optional_parameters.description: Vehicle model year.

optional_parameters.name: drive
optional_parameters.description: Drive transmission. Possible values: fwd (front-wheel drive), rwd (rear-wheel drive), awd (all-wheel drive), 4wd (four-wheel drive)

optional_parameters.name: fuel_type
optional_parameters.description: Type of fuel used. Possible values: gas, diesel, electricity

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: How many results to return. Must be between 1 and 30.

get_animal_facts.description: Provides interesting scientific facts on thousands of different animal species.

required_parameters.name: name
required_parameters.description: Common name of animal to search. This parameter supports partial matches (e.g. fox will match gray fox and red fox).

get_divisions_near_location.description: Returns a list of administrative divisions (cities, counties, islands, or regions) located within a specified radius of a given GPS coordinate. Each result includes the division's name, country, region, population, and distance from the specified location. Supports filtering by country, time zone, population range, and name prefix. Results can be displayed in multiple languages and sorted by various fields.

required_parameters.name: locationId
required_parameters.description: The GPS coordinate of the center location, must follow ISO-6709 format (e.g. +34.05+118.24 or +34.05-118.24) where + denotes North/East and - denotes South/West.

required_parameters.name: radius
required_parameters.description: The search radius around the specified GPS location within which to find nearby divisions.

optional_parameters.name: distanceUnit
optional_parameters.description: The unit of distance to use for the radius. Accepted values: 'MI' (miles) or 'KM' (kilometers).

optional_parameters.name: countryIds
optional_parameters.description: Restrict results to divisions within these countries only. Provide a comma-delimited list of ISO country codes or WikiData IDs (e.g., 'US,CA').

optional_parameters.name: excludedCountryIds
optional_parameters.description: Exclude divisions belonging to these countries from the results. Provide a comma-delimited list of ISO country codes or WikiData IDs.

optional_parameters.name: timeZoneIds
optional_parameters.description: Restrict results to divisions located within these time zones only. Provide a comma-delimited list of time-zone IDs (e.g., 'America/New_York,Europe/London').

optional_parameters.name: minPopulation
optional_parameters.description: Only include divisions with a population greater than or equal to this value.

optional_parameters.name: maxPopulation
optional_parameters.description: Only include divisions with a population less than or equal to this value.

optional_parameters.name: namePrefix
optional_parameters.description: Only return divisions whose names start with this prefix. If 'languageCode' is also set, the prefix is matched against the name in that language.

optional_parameters.name: namePrefixDefaultLangResults
optional_parameters.description: When performing name-prefix matching with a non-default language set, whether to also match against names in the default language.

optional_parameters.name: languageCode
optional_parameters.description: Return results with place names displayed in this language (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'fr', 'ru').

optional_parameters.name: asciiMode
optional_parameters.description: If true, display results using ASCII characters only, removing diacritics and special characters.

optional_parameters.name: hateoasMode
optional_parameters.description: If true, include HATEOAS-style pagination links in the response.

optional_parameters.name: includeDeleted
optional_parameters.description: Whether to include divisions that have been marked as deleted. Accepted values: 'ALL', 'SINCE_YESTERDAY', 'SINCE_LAST_WEEK', 'NONE'.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: The maximum number of division results to return per request.

optional_parameters.name: offset
optional_parameters.description: The zero-based offset into the result set, used for pagination.

optional_parameters.name: sort
optional_parameters.description: Specify how to sort the results. Format: '±SORT_FIELD,±SORT_FIELD' where '+' means ascending and '-' means descending. SORT_FIELD options: 'countryCode', 'elevation', 'name', 'population'. Example: '-population,+name'.

search_public_restrooms.description: Searches for public bathrooms, toilets, and restrooms worldwide. The database has over 60,000+ entries and supports searching by location and pagination.

optional_parameters.name: states
optional_parameters.description: A comma-separated list of US state abbreviations to filter the search (e.g., NY,FL).

optional_parameters.name: lat
optional_parameters.description: Latitude of the desired location for proximity search.

optional_parameters.name: lon
optional_parameters.description: Longitude of the desired location for proximity search. Must be supplied if 'lat' is used.

optional_parameters.name: page
optional_parameters.description: The page number for result pagination.

optional_parameters.name: per_page
optional_parameters.description: The number of results to return per page.

get_dog_breeds_metadata.description: Searches for and retrieves basic metadata for specific dog breeds from around the world based on a search term.

required_parameters.name: search
required_parameters.description: Search term to query for dog breeds. Supports partial matching (e.g., 'alaskan' will match 'Alaskan Husky' or 'Alaskan Malamute').

search_exercises_by_name.description: Searches for exercises using a case-insensitive substring match on the exercise name. Returns detailed exercise information including the target muscle group, secondary muscles, required equipment, step-by-step instructions, difficulty level, and category. Results can be sorted and paginated.

required_parameters.name: name
required_parameters.description: A name fragment used for case-insensitive substring matching against exercise names (e.g., 'arm' matches 'band kneeling one arm pulldown', 'arm curl', etc.).

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: The maximum number of exercise results to return per request. Use 0 to return the full result set (non-BASIC plans only). BASIC plans are capped at 10.

optional_parameters.name: offset
optional_parameters.description: The zero-based start index into the result set, used for pagination (e.g., 0 for the first page, 10 for the second page when limit is 10).

optional_parameters.name: sortOrder
optional_parameters.description: The sort direction for results. Accepted values: 'ascending' or 'descending'.

optional_parameters.name: sortMethod
optional_parameters.description: The field to sort results by. Accepted values: 'bodyPart', 'id', 'name', 'target', 'equipment', 'difficulty', 'category'.

get_media_news.description: Access current and trending news and articles related to movies, TV shows, and celebrities. Allows filtering by media category, country, and language, and supports result pagination.

optional_parameters.name: category
optional_parameters.description: The type of media or topic to search for. One of the followings: TOP (Trending/General News), MOVIE, TV, CELEBRITY, UNKNOWN.

optional_parameters.name: first
optional_parameters.description: The number of news items per response for paging purpose.

optional_parameters.name: after
optional_parameters.description: Paging cursor. Leave empty to load the first page, or use the value of 'endCursor' from the previous response to load the next page.

optional_parameters.name: country
optional_parameters.description: The country code. Must be used in pair with the 'language' parameter.

optional_parameters.name: language
optional_parameters.description: The language code. Must be used in pair with the 'country' parameter to get news information in the related language if available.

search_manga.description: Searches for manga based on title, author, or keywords, with filtering options for NSFW content and the manga's origin (Japan, China, or Korea).

required_parameters.name: text
required_parameters.description: The search term to query for manga title or content (e.g., 'Naruto').

optional_parameters.name: nsfw
optional_parameters.description: Filter results by Not Safe For Work status. Use 'true' to get all manga (NSFW and non-NSFW), use 'false' to get only non-NSFW manga.

optional_parameters.name: type
optional_parameters.description: The origin of the manga. Please choose from 'all', 'japan', 'china', or 'korea'.

get_financial_data.description: Customizable Endpoint for various financial data functions.

required_parameters.name: function
required_parameters.description: The function of your choice (This is required for all API calls). For this example, the value is GLOBAL_QUOTE.

required_parameters.name: symbol
required_parameters.description: Any additional optional parameters may be added. Some functions have multiple required parameters, check the documentation for more information.

convert_currency.description: Convert currency using the three-letter currency codes.

required_parameters.name: base
required_parameters.description: The three-letter currency code of the currency you would like to convert from.

required_parameters.name: target
required_parameters.description: The three-letter currency code of the currency you would like to convert to.

calculate_mortgage_payment.description: Provides detailed mortgage and other home financing payment information. It uses the standard mortgage calculation formulas to calculate interest and monthly/annual payments.

required_parameters.name: interest_rate
required_parameters.description: Annual interest rate (in %). For example, a 3.5% interest rate would be 3.5. Cannot exceed 10000.

optional_parameters.name: loan_amount
optional_parameters.description: Principal loan amount.

optional_parameters.name: home_value
optional_parameters.description: Total value of the home or asset. Must be greater than downpayment.

optional_parameters.name: downpayment
optional_parameters.description: Downpayment on the home or asset. Cannot exceed home_value.

optional_parameters.name: duration_years
optional_parameters.description: Duration of the loan in years. Must be between 1 and 10000. If not set, default value is 30 years.

optional_parameters.name: monthly_hoa
optional_parameters.description: Monthly homeowner association fees.

optional_parameters.name: annual_property_tax
optional_parameters.description: Annual property tax owed.

optional_parameters.name: annual_home_insurance
optional_parameters.description: Annual homeowner's insurance bill.

get_recipe.description: Searches for recipes where the dish name includes the query text.

required_parameters.name: query
required_parameters.description: query text to search.

search_cocktails.description: Searches for cocktail recipes and information based on the cocktail's name or a list of required ingredients.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: Name of the cocktail. This parameter supports partial matches (e.g., 'bloody' will match 'bloody mary' and 'bloody margarita').

optional_parameters.name: ingredients
optional_parameters.description: A comma-separated string of ingredients to search (e.g., 'vodka,lemon juice'). Only cocktails containing ALL listed ingredients will be returned.

get_all_mvc2_characters.description: Access all characters in MVC2 (Marvel Vs Capcom) Universe

get_filtered_game_giveaways.description: Filter and group platforms and giveaway types to get personalized results.

required_parameters.name: platform
required_parameters.description: The gaming platform(s) to filter by. (e.g., epic-games-store, steam, android)

optional_parameters.name: type
optional_parameters.description: The type of giveaway to filter by. (e.g., game, loot)

get_lol_champion_stats.description: Retrieves the basic metadata and detailed in-game statistics for a specific League of Legends champion, including health, mana, attack damage, and various scaling stats.

required_parameters.name: name
required_parameters.description: The name of the League of Legends champion to query (e.g., 'Ekko', 'Jhin').

get_salary_estimation.description: Retrieves detailed salary estimation data, including minimum, maximum, and median base/total salary, for a specified job title and location, with optional filtering by location type and years of experience.

required_parameters.name: job_title
required_parameters.description: The job title for which to get salary estimation (e.g., 'nodejs developer').

required_parameters.name: location
required_parameters.description: The free-text location/area in which to get salary estimation (e.g., 'new york').

optional_parameters.name: location_type
optional_parameters.description: Specify the type of the location for additional accuracy. Allowed values: ANY, CITY, STATE, COUNTRY.

optional_parameters.name: years_of_experience
optional_parameters.description: Get job estimation for a specific experience level range (years). Allowed values: ALL, LESS_THAN_ONE, ONE_TO_THREE, FOUR_TO_SIX, SEVEN_TO_NINE, TEN_TO_FOURTEEN, ABOVE_FIFTEEN.

optional_parameters.name: fields
optional_parameters.description: A comma separated list of job salary fields to include in the response (field projection). By default all fields are returned. Example: 'job_title,median_salary,location'.

get_timezone_info.description: Provides time zone information, including UTC and DST offsets, for any specified point on land based on latitude, longitude, and an optional UNIX timestamp. Note: Accuracy is not guaranteed for historical timestamps due to potential changes in time zone boundaries.

required_parameters.name: lat
required_parameters.description: The latitude component of any point on land.

required_parameters.name: lng
required_parameters.description: The longitude component of any point on land.

optional_parameters.name: timestamp
optional_parameters.description: The UNIX timestamp at which the UTC and DST offsets will be calculated. Defaults to the present time.

calculate_route.description: Provides detailed routing information based on multiple waypoints. Supports various route types, custom layout weights, language-specific directions, and voice instructions.

required_parameters.name: points
required_parameters.description: Define multiple routing waypoints, consisting of latitude and longitude in the format '{lat},{lng}[|{lat},{lng} ...]'. At least 2 points are required.

optional_parameters.name: routeType
optional_parameters.description: The vehicle for which the route should be calculated. Available options: car, bike, foot, or transit (transit is currently restricted to NRW, Germany).

optional_parameters.name: weighting
optional_parameters.description: Special weighting of the routing. Only available for the routeType 'bike'. Available options: networks, shortest, fastest.

optional_parameters.name: language
optional_parameters.description: Language for the given instructions. Must be a valid ISO 639-1 language code.

optional_parameters.name: voice_instructions
optional_parameters.description: Enables voice instructions for text to speech engines, extending the instructions attribute. 0=disabled, 1=enabled.

optional_parameters.name: finish_instruction
optional_parameters.description: Set to 1 if you need a finish-instruction (with sign 4) in the instruction-list. 0=disabled, 1=enabled.

optional_parameters.name: format
optional_parameters.description: Specifies the resulting format of the route. Available options: json, gpx, kml.

optional_parameters.name: filename
optional_parameters.description: The file name assigned to the output. Only available if the set format is 'gpx' or 'kml'.

get_planet_data.description: Provides astronomical data on thousands of planets and exoplanets discovered in our universe.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: Name of the planet.

optional_parameters.name: min_mass
optional_parameters.description: Minimum mass of the planet in Jupiters (1 Jupiter = 1.898 × 10^27 kg).

optional_parameters.name: max_mass
optional_parameters.description: Maximum mass of the planet in Jupiters (1 Jupiter = 1.898 × 10^27 kg).

optional_parameters.name: min_radius
optional_parameters.description: Minimum average radius of the planet in Jupiters (1 Jupiter = 69911 km).

optional_parameters.name: max_radius
optional_parameters.description: Maximum average radius of the planet in Jupiters (1 Jupiter = 69911 km).

optional_parameters.name: min_period
optional_parameters.description: Minimum orbital period of the planet in Earth days.

optional_parameters.name: max_period
optional_parameters.description: Maximum orbital period of the planet in Earth days.

optional_parameters.name: min_temperature
optional_parameters.description: Minimum average surface temperature of the planet in Kelvin.

optional_parameters.name: max_temperature
optional_parameters.description: Maximum average surface temperature of the planet in Kelvin.

optional_parameters.name: min_distance_light_year
optional_parameters.description: Minimum distance the planet is from Earth in light years.

optional_parameters.name: max_distance_light_year
optional_parameters.description: Maximum distance the planet is from Earth in light years.

get_celestial_body_position.description: Retrieves astronomical position data (e.g., azimuth, altitude) for a celestial body based on the observer's location (latitude, longitude, elevation) and a specified date and time range.

required_parameters.name: body
required_parameters.description: The name of the celestial body (e.g., 'Sun', 'Moon', 'Mars', 'Jupiter') whose position is being requested.

required_parameters.name: latitude
required_parameters.description: The latitude component of the observer's location.

required_parameters.name: longitude
required_parameters.description: The longitude component of the observer's location.

required_parameters.name: from_date
required_parameters.description: The start date for the query in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format.

required_parameters.name: to_date
required_parameters.description: The end date for the query in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format.

optional_parameters.name: elevation
optional_parameters.description: The elevation (in meters) of the observer's location.

optional_parameters.name: time
optional_parameters.description: The time component to be used with the date (e.g., 'HH:MM:SS'). If not specified, a default time will be used.

search_arxiv_papers.description: Provides a way to search the arXiv repository for scientific papers using a variety of filters and search parameters.

required_parameters.name: search_term
required_parameters.description: Search term to query arXiv.

optional_parameters.name: date_from
optional_parameters.description: The start date for filtering papers by submission date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

optional_parameters.name: start
optional_parameters.description: The starting index for pagination. Default is 0 (first page).

optional_parameters.name: date_type
optional_parameters.description: The type of date to filter papers by.

optional_parameters.name: field
optional_parameters.description: The field to search in. Options are 'Title', 'Authors', 'Comments', or 'All fields'.

optional_parameters.name: date_to
optional_parameters.description: The end date for filtering papers by submission date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

optional_parameters.name: num_results
optional_parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return.

get_f1_latest_news.description: This endpoint returns back recent articles from all sources

get_handball_scheduled_matches.description:
Daily match list including scheduled matches.

**The data will return for only -+7 days period, so endpoint can be tested with date range of today - 7 days.**

required_parameters.name: date
required_parameters.description: The date of the match. The format is {dd/MM/yyyy}. Match list data can be retrieved for only ± 7 days.

get_airlines.description: Searches for airline information using various identifiers or name.

optional_parameters.name: icao
optional_parameters.description: International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) 3-character airline code.

optional_parameters.name: iata
optional_parameters.description: International Air Transport Association (IATA) 2-character airline code.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: Airline name. This parameter supports partial matching (e.g. United will match United Airlines)

get_flights_in_bounding_box.description: Retrieves real-time flight data within a specified geographic bounding box defined by bottom-left and top-right coordinates, with options to filter by aircraft characteristics, speed, and airline.

required_parameters.name: bl_lat
required_parameters.description: The bottom left latitude of the bounding box.

required_parameters.name: bl_lng
required_parameters.description: The bottom left longitude of the bounding box.

required_parameters.name: tr_lat
required_parameters.description: The top right latitude of the bounding box.

required_parameters.name: tr_lng
required_parameters.description: The top right longitude of the bounding box.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: The number of flights per response. Cannot exceed 300.

optional_parameters.name: speed
optional_parameters.description: Filter flights by ground speed. The format must be 'min,max'. For example: '0,460'.

optional_parameters.name: altitude
optional_parameters.description: Filter flights by altitude. The format must be 'min,max'. For example: '0,48000'.

optional_parameters.name: airline
optional_parameters.description: Filter flights by airline. Enter the 3-letter ICAO airline code (e.g., 'THA' for Thai Airways).

optional_parameters.name: type
optional_parameters.description: Filter flights by aircraft type. Enter the ICAO or IATA aircraft type code (e.g., 'A359' or '77W').

optional_parameters.name: airport
optional_parameters.description: Filter flights by airport. Enter the 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g., 'BKK' or 'TPE').

optional_parameters.name: reg
optional_parameters.description: Filter flights by aircraft registration number. For example: 'D-AIHV'.

get_motorcycle_data.description: Provides highly-detailed technical data on tens of thousands of different motorcycle models from hundreds of manufacturers.

optional_parameters.name: make
optional_parameters.description: Name of manufacturer/brand. Supports partial matching (e.g. Harley will match Harley-Davidson).

optional_parameters.name: model
optional_parameters.description: Name of motorcycle model. Supports partial matching (e.g. Ninja will match Ninja 650).

optional_parameters.name: year
optional_parameters.description: Release year of motorcycle model. Must be in the form of YYYY (e.g. 2022).

get_air_quality_data.description: Provides the latest air quality information for any city or geographic location in the world, including the Air Quality Index (AQI) and concentrations for major pollutants (CO, NO2, O3, SO2, PM2.5, PM10).

optional_parameters.name: lat
optional_parameters.description: Latitude of desired location. If used, the 'lon' parameter must also be supplied.

optional_parameters.name: lon
optional_parameters.description: Longitude of desired location. If used, the 'lat' parameter must also be supplied.

optional_parameters.name: city
optional_parameters.description: City name.

optional_parameters.name: state
optional_parameters.description: US state (United States only).

optional_parameters.name: country
optional_parameters.description: Country name.

get_weather_forecast.description: Provides up to 14-day hourly and 15-minute weather forecast data.

required_parameters.name: q
required_parameters.description: Query parameter based on which data is sent back. Can be Latitude and Longitude (e.g: 48.8567,2.3508), city name (e.g: Paris), US zip, UK/Canada postal code, metar code (e.g: metar:EGLL), IATA code (e.g: iata:DXB), or IP address (e.g: auto:ip or 100.0.0.1).

optional_parameters.name: days
optional_parameters.description: Number of days of forecast required (up to 14 days).

search_amazon_products.description: Search for Amazon products using keywords and filters. Returns real-time product listings including titles, prices, ratings, and availability from Amazon's marketplace.

required_parameters.name: query
required_parameters.description: The search keyword or phrase to look up on Amazon (e.g., 'wireless headphones', 'laptop stand').

optional_parameters.name: page
optional_parameters.description: Page number for pagination of results. Starts at 1.

optional_parameters.name: country
optional_parameters.description: Amazon marketplace country code (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'CA', 'DE', 'JP'). Default is 'US'.

optional_parameters.name: sort_by
optional_parameters.description: Sort order for results. Options: 'RELEVANCE', 'LOWEST_PRICE', 'HIGHEST_PRICE', 'REVIEWS', 'NEWEST'. Default is 'RELEVANCE'.

optional_parameters.name: product_condition
optional_parameters.description: Filter by product condition. Options: 'ALL', 'NEW', 'USED', 'RENEWED'. Default is 'ALL'.

optional_parameters.name: min_price
optional_parameters.description: Minimum price filter in the marketplace's local currency.

optional_parameters.name: max_price
optional_parameters.description: Maximum price filter in the marketplace's local currency.

search_streaming_shows.description: Search for movies and TV shows available on streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max, and 20+ others) across 60+ countries, with filters for genre, show type, and release year.

required_parameters.name: country
required_parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to search streaming availability in (e.g., 'us', 'gb', 'ca', 'jp', 'au').

optional_parameters.name: catalogs
optional_parameters.description: Comma-separated streaming service IDs to filter by (e.g., 'netflix', 'prime', 'disney', 'hulu', 'hbo'). If omitted, searches all available services.

optional_parameters.name: show_type
optional_parameters.description: Filter by content type. Options: 'movie', 'series'. If omitted, returns both.

optional_parameters.name: genres
optional_parameters.description: Comma-separated genre IDs to filter by (e.g., 'action', 'comedy', 'drama', 'thriller').

optional_parameters.name: keyword
optional_parameters.description: Keyword to search for within show titles or descriptions.

optional_parameters.name: order_by
optional_parameters.description: Field to sort results by. Options: 'original_title', 'release_year', 'rating', 'popularity_alltime', 'popularity_1year', 'popularity_1month', 'popularity_1week'. Default is 'original_title'.

optional_parameters.name: order_direction
optional_parameters.description: Sort direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Default is 'asc'.

get_restaurants_by_location.description: Search for restaurants within a geographic bounding box using GPS coordinates. Returns restaurant listings including name, cuisine, rating, and contact information, replicating TripAdvisor's restaurant search.

required_parameters.name: bl_latitude
required_parameters.description: Bottom-left (southwest) latitude of the bounding box search area.

required_parameters.name: tr_latitude
required_parameters.description: Top-right (northeast) latitude of the bounding box search area.

required_parameters.name: bl_longitude
required_parameters.description: Bottom-left (southwest) longitude of the bounding box search area.

required_parameters.name: tr_longitude
required_parameters.description: Top-right (northeast) longitude of the bounding box search area.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: Maximum number of restaurant results to return per request.

optional_parameters.name: currency
optional_parameters.description: Currency code for price display (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'TWD').

optional_parameters.name: offset
optional_parameters.description: Pagination offset for retrieving subsequent pages of results.

optional_parameters.name: lang
optional_parameters.description: Language/locale code for the response (e.g., 'en_US', 'zh_TW', 'ja_JP').

get_hotels_by_location.description: Search for hotels within a geographic bounding box using GPS coordinates and travel dates. Returns hotel listings with pricing, ratings, and availability, replicating TripAdvisor's hotel search feature.

required_parameters.name: bl_latitude
required_parameters.description: Bottom-left (southwest) latitude of the bounding box search area.

required_parameters.name: tr_latitude
required_parameters.description: Top-right (northeast) latitude of the bounding box search area.

required_parameters.name: bl_longitude
required_parameters.description: Bottom-left (southwest) longitude of the bounding box search area.

required_parameters.name: tr_longitude
required_parameters.description: Top-right (northeast) longitude of the bounding box search area.

required_parameters.name: checkin
required_parameters.description: Check-in date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

required_parameters.name: checkout
required_parameters.description: Check-out date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

optional_parameters.name: adults
optional_parameters.description: Number of adult guests. Default is 2.

optional_parameters.name: rooms
optional_parameters.description: Number of rooms required. Default is 1.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: Maximum number of hotel results to return per request.

optional_parameters.name: currency
